message.content: Determining the “best” soccer player at any given moment is always a matter of opinion and depends on the criteria you use—goals, assists, influence on games, trophies, or overall skill. As of now (mid‑2026), many pundits and fans still consider **Lionel Messi** and **Kylian Mbappé** to be the top two players in the world. Messi’s combination of playmaking, finishing, and longevity keeps him in the conversation, while Mbappé’s speed, goal‑scoring prowess, and impact in big matches make him a strong contender for the title of the best current player. Other names that frequently surface include **Erling Haaland** (for his goal‑scoring record) and **Kevin De Bruyne** (for his creative midfield mastery). Ultimately, the “best” player can vary depending on whether you’re looking at club performance, international play, or individual accolades.
